question: By what prior model should the full practice of this mantra be understood?
premises: Meditation, worship, application, and so on are included.
All these are to be known.
They follow the model of the six-syllable mantra.
inference: The entire practice should be understood as like that of the six-syllable mantra.
plain_english: Meditation, worship, application, and everything else should be understood as in the case of the six-syllable mantra.
